facts.label: In English
facts.value: Green Dragon sluice and dam at 青龙桥

facts.label: What it was
facts.value: a sluice outside the garden walls

facts.label: In 1860
facts.value: in use; opened only in high water (S05 j99:5b)

facts.label: Where
facts.value: today's 青龙桥 (osm node 2264607857): the bridge of the same name on the same stream (B)

facts.label: Note
facts.value: [j99:5b] 青龍閘非盛漲不啟奉宸苑司其事. Malone p.121: at 青龙桥 'a dam dating from the time of Kublai Khan holds back the waters of the Jade Fountain from flowing into the Ch'ing River, and thus forms the K'un Ming Lake'. The parting of the waters.
